sentences.en: You guys can't envision the final collapse of capitalism? Incredible!
sentences.zh: 你们难道想象不出资本主义最终会崩溃吗？太不可思议了！

sentences.en: Yanni pushed himself beyond what his conscious mind could envision.
sentences.zh: 雅尼超越了他的意识所能想象的极限。

sentences.en: Many envision that Mars will be humanity's second planetary home.
sentences.zh: 许多人设想火星将成为人类的第二个家园。
